About the author

M. Monique is a bestselling author who hails from Pensacola, Florida. She published her first novel, A Thug Has Feelings Too, in 2020. Since her debut release, she has penned several novels, including the Summers Series, featuring Uncovering Love, Blu, Kingston, and August. Her love for writing compelling stories dates back to her childhood. When she isn't writing, M.
